reason: The document states substantive RPO relocation assistance for demolition of Protected Units: Chart B amounts $87,450-$115,480 for 2026-27, with RSO/JCO minimums. Relocation assistance falls in the just_cause_eviction category, and this is more than a notice rule. Effective date 2/11/2025, ordinance numbers, penalty and quote are all stated in the document.

rule.title: Resident Protections Ordinance relocation for demolition
rule.requirement: If a Los Angeles landlord demolishes a protected unit to build new housing, lower-income tenants must get enhanced relocation payments (for 2026-27, up to $115,480 under the standard option), and all tenants get at least the RSO or JCO amount.
rule.requirement_es: Si un propietario en Los Ángeles demuele una unidad protegida para construir nueva vivienda, los inquilinos de bajos ingresos deben recibir pagos de reubicación mayores (para 2026-27, hasta $115,480 bajo la opción estándar), y todos los inquilinos reciben al menos el monto de RSO o JCO.
rule.coverage_text: Protected Units demolished for new construction within 5 years after filing the Notice of Intent to Withdraw or Declaration of Intent to Evict; Protected Units include all RSO units and units with recent affordability covenants, rent control, lower-income occupants, or Ellis Act withdrawal.
rule.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.
rule.quote:
Owners who demolish a Protected Unit for the purpose of new construction within 5 years after the 
filing of the Notice of Intent to Withdraw or Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD are required to 
comply with relocation requirements under the RPO.
